title: Navigation payload: into service
summary: Bring the navigation payload of a MEO satellite into service after maintenance.
goals: Learn the navigation payload chain: clocks, signal generator, amplifier, antenna
situation: The payload was switched off for maintenance. Navigation users need the signal back. The atomic clocks need about 30 minutes to warm up and lock before the signal is valid.

steps.text: Switch the atomic clocks on: pl.clocks ON.
Wait for the clocks to lock.
steps.hint: 'Atomic clocks lock' goes from WARMING UP to LOCKED. Use time warp.

steps.text: Switch on the signal generator: pl.nsgu ON.
Switch on the amplifier: pl.amp ON.
steps.hint: It is the biggest power user on board.

steps.text: Keep the signal in service for 10 minutes.
steps.hint: Service needs every chain unit working, clocks locked and the antenna pointing at the Earth within 1 deg.

successText: Signal in service. Users on the ground can use this satellite again.
